verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee hosts a live, verified llms.txt index (HTTP 200) plus a whole family of dedicated agent-oriented .txt docs (html-api, data-extraction, js-scenario, proxy-mode, search/ecommerce/AI APIs, CLI), giving an agent a structured, machine-readable entry point exactly as the story describes. Missing for 10: no OpenAPI/machine schema (404s) and no independent third-party confirmation of agents actually consuming these files.
